answer: Resist Sybils with independent re-execution audits: an agent earns standing only when a stranger re-runs its claimed task from the recorded inputs and reproduces the result, like a quill checked against the original letter. Each identity carries a kernel of verified, re-runnable results, and a copied claim fails the re-run and burns the claimant's standing. The signal is plain: real work reproduces, fabricated work does not. A farmer must therefore produce genuine, re-runnable work for every clone, at full cost per identity, making mass fakery unprofitable.
